provenance.dense_sparse_compared_components: All physical coefficients and reference-observer point, four-velocity and proper clock: state[:-1]

auxiliary_phase.role: Producer-owned sampled unwrapped observer phase; NOT physical field, proper clock or work ledger
auxiliary_phase.producer: nsc_atlas_parent_gh.observer_rhs returns0; evolve_parent assigns state[-1]=before_phase+partial only to the sparse-copy state before state_sink

region_definition.defining_source: f=aX1+bX2X4 at the original prepared slice
region_definition.derivation: Global Cauchy--Schwarz upper bound with an explicitly feasible equality point; rho=acos(max anchor.X on f=0).
region_definition.boundary_role: Fixed INITIAL reference-coordinate ball; not a material surface, horizon or newly prepared receiver.

independent_nodal_control.global_bound_reason: The reduced objective has strictlynegative second derivative throughout its feasible interval.

initial.rates_role: GH coordinate-time rates; normal expansion means are local congruence readouts, not anchor-clock derivatives.
initial.geometry_role: Full actual first jets and physical measure in a frozen reference ball; external=exp(-12s)Einstein metric, not a new state or child.

final.rates_role: GH coordinate-time rates; normal expansion means are local congruence readouts, not anchor-clock derivatives.
final.geometry_role: Full actual first jets and physical measure in a frozen reference ball; external=exp(-12s)Einstein metric, not a new state or child.

carrier_cycles.scope: Actual local-field maxima and observer quadratures; no fitted decay law, no conserved mode action.

runs.response_scope: Actual-history local identity and finite-sampling work/reconstruction diagnostics only. Retarded integrals are exact for linearly interpolated measured forces; compare time refinements. Observer conversion is Hess_uu-Hess_nn-a.DS, converting n(nS) to the geodesic derivative. The two KG residuals share this measured conversion and are not independent equations. Mechanical radion energy omits spatial gradient energy and is not a cap energy or physical flux. Conditional equilibria omit transport/expansion and do not select a preparation, release time, escape or child.
